name: comp-aws — Comprehensive AWS Cloud Compiler + Certified Resource Graph + Cloud-Shape Snapshot Archive
description: Andrew-direct MAJOR scope-up generalizing comp-lambdamap (the Lambda source-map drift compiler) to the ENTIRE AWS surface. Ships a batch compiler that derives a TYPED, CERTIFIED graph of the whole cloud — every resource categorized + typed, every relationship captured — reconciled across three sources of truth (Terraform IaC / live-AWS / on-disk source) and validated against a HUMAN hand-audit until 0-diff ('everything categorized, typed, perfect'). NODE taxonomy: Lambda (done via comp-lambdamap) / EC2 / S3 (+bucket policies) / DynamoDB / IAM (comp-iam) / CloudFront / EventBridge / SNS / SQS / StepFunctions / Secrets / KMS / CloudWatch. EDGE taxonomy (all relationships): compute->IAM->policy, compute->S3/Dynamo/Secrets/KMS, event triggers, CloudFront->origin, TF-module->resource, declared<->live drift, pipeline DAG. Populates the existing comp-graph that comp-trace / comp-blast / comp-iam already consume. CERT LOOP (Andrew's method): Phase-0 human hand-audit (CVO + AE, the oracle) -> per-class sub-compilers -> diff-vs-audit-until-0-diff -> compiler becomes source-of-truth + the hand-audit becomes the regression fixture. SNAPSHOT ARCHIVE (PRD section 6a, Andrew addendum): every derive run persists a timestamped + TF-commit-stamped GZIPPED TARBALL of the canonical JSON graph to a dedicated cloud-shapes folder (agent-readable shape-history + latest-pointer + index) for backup / diff-over-time / forensics; durability via S3-archive + local-recent-N (retention = TO-decomposition call). SCALABILITY: static IaC compile measured ~0.33s/169-lambdas (comp-lambdamap) -> whole-cloud static sub-10s, CI-able; live-AWS reconcile is the cost driver, snapshot-cached not per-run. SUBSUMES comp-lambdamap's Phase-2 (comp-lambdamap is now the Lambda sub-module of comp-aws); comp-iam is the IAM sub-compiler — both absorbed, no duplication.
source_brief: Andrew-direct ('a script that does that categorically' -> 'comprehensive AWS cloud compiler') via the CVO lambda-source-map parity audit (359375d87) that first surfaced the written-and-aging-not-compiled deploy-ledger class. comp-lambdamap (Phase-1 218c1b289 + Phase-2d 741b6d214/350c862f9; found a bonus latent seeking-alpha TF source_dir drift bug) is the proven Lambda-class precursor; CTO generalized it to the whole cloud surface in PRD d425e072f, recommending formal ADHC project registration (multi-phase + fabric-significant). Registered by 2.0.0_SA_COO per CTO TO-decomposition request 2026-06-01.
phase: Phase 0 — REGISTERED 2026-06-01 (2.0.0_SA_COO) from ws CTO PRD v0.1 (d425e072f). DECOMPOSITION SEQUENCE (per PRD owners-section + CTO recommendation): (Phase-0, LONG POLE + highest-value) CVO+AE human hand-audit of the whole-cloud resource+edge inventory = the certification oracle; (Sub-compiler sequence) lambda DONE (comp-lambdamap, absorbed) -> S3+IAM next (recent operational pain — BMKAUD bucket-policy Deny census + comp-iam) -> EC2/DynamoDB/eventing (EventBridge/SNS/SQS/StepFn) -> edge/network (CloudFront->origin) -> observability (CloudWatch); each sub-compiler diffs-vs-hand-audit until 0-diff then becomes source-of-truth. Section-6a snapshot-archive (gzipped TF-commit-stamped canonical-graph tarballs + S3 durability + local-recent-N) is a cross-cutting mechanism shipped alongside the first sub-compiler. OWNERS: ws CTO = design + type schema; 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps = mechanism (build); 3.0.0_SA_CVO = hand-audit + certify (the oracle + write-gate on any --write); 2.0.0_SA_COO = decompose + register (done) + drive. BUILD-RAMP SEQUENCING (COO): this is sanctioned capacity-fill scope-up, NOT critical-path — the build ramps as AE capacity frees (AE flagged a clean session-checkpoint 2026-06-01 after an exceptional session; BMKAUD durability-TF #1 is Andrew-gated; the MDPF Schwab re-derive verify is the live critical-path). First build move = Phase-0 hand-audit scoping (CVO+AE) which does not require fresh AE deep-build capacity, can begin parallel to Schwab close. TO authoring deferred to a focused pass; PRD section references carry the AC detail.
blocking: None blocking registration. Build-ramp gated on capacity (not a hard blocker): AE 0.7 at a clean checkpoint post-long-session; comp-lambdamap remaining Phase-2 (a) SHA-vs-live-CodeSha256 + (b) multi-runtime dir enum + (c) CVO-gated derive --write fold INTO comp-aws as the Lambda sub-module's completion (do not double-build). Phase-0 hand-audit (CVO+AE) is the long pole + can begin without fresh AE deep-build capacity. derive --write on any source-of-truth file is CVO-gated (the no-absent-dir / disk-existence-tiebreaker guard CVO surfaced in comp-lambdamap Phase-1 generalizes: never rewrite a correct on-disk/live value to a drifted IaC value; the compiler reconciles direction-aware).
depends_on_note: Builds on / absorbs the comp-* compiler family: comp-lambdamap (Lambda sub-module, ADHC capacity-fill enhancement — Phase-1 done, Phase-2 folds in), comp-iam (IAM sub-compiler), comp-graph (the populated graph comp-trace/comp-blast consume). Adjacent to ADHC_DRIFTD (deploy-record drift detection — comp-aws generalizes the drift-detection class to the whole cloud, declared<->live edge). No blocking cross-dependency; sequencing only.
pipeline: compiler toolchain (.tools/comp-*, org/modules/graph/, the comp-graph), AWS infra (Terraform infra/aws/, live-AWS via boto3), cloud-shapes snapshot archive (S3 + local-recent-N)
